home.heroSubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa ihuza ibikoresho bikoreshwa bwa kabiri n'abahanzi b'impuguke kugira ngo bakore ubuhanzi budasanzwe, bufite ingaruka zemejwe. Buri gice gifite inkuru y'ihinduka.

home.aboutP1: RenewCanvas Africa ni urubuga rw'ubuhanzi buzunguruka rushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga ruhindura ikibazo cy'imyanda kikaba amahirwe yo guhanga. Dukusanya ibikoresho runaka bikoreshwa bwa kabiri, tukabigeza ku bahanzi batoranyijwe, hanyuma tugahuza ibikorwa byabo bidasanzwe n'abaguzi bahesha agaciro kuramba no ku ngaruka.
home.aboutP2: Buri gikorwa cy'ubuhanzi kuri urubuga rwacu kiza gifite inkuru yemejwe y'ingaruka ku bidukikije, ku buryo uzamenya neza imyanda ingana iyo yakuweho, umuhanzi wakikoze, n'urugendo kuva mu kintu cyataye kugeza ku gikorwa cy'ubuhanzi gihesha agaciro.
home.aboutP3: Ntabwo turi isoko gusa. Turi ihinduka rigamije kwerekana ko imyanda ishobora kuba nziza, ko abahanzi b'Abanyafurika bakwiye kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga, kandi ko abaguzi bafite ubwenge bashobora gutera imbere mu buryo nyabwo.

home.step2Desc: Abahanzi bacu batoranyijwe bahindura ibi bikoresho ibishushanyo bitangaje, ibishushanyo bicukuwe, imitako, n'ibikoresho byo mu rugo.
home.step3Desc: Buri gikorwa cy'ubuhanzi kibikwa hamwe n'ingaruka zacyo ku bidukikije: kilo z'imyanda yakuweho, ibikoresho byakoreshejwe, n'amafaranga umuhanzi yinjije.

howItWorks.processSubtitle: Urugendo rugaragara kandi rushobora gukurikiranwa kuva ku byatawe kugeza ku gikorwa cy'ubuhanzi gikundwa mu mwanya wawe.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Dufatanya n'abakora imyanda, amasosiyete y'ongera gukoresha, amashuri, n'ubucuruzi mu gukusanya ibikoresho bimwe byongera gukoreshwa. Buri murundo ufite amakuru y'inkomoko kugira ngo bishoboke gukurikiranwa neza.
howItWorks.step1Detail1: Amacupa y'ibikoresho biva mu kintu n'ibifuniko
howItWorks.step2Desc: Ibikoresho byose byakusanyijwe binyura mu nzira yacu ikomeye yo gusukura no gutondeka. Twemeza ko ibikoresho byizewe, byasukuwe gusa bigera ku bahanzi bacu.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Abahanzi bacu basuzumwe bakira ibikoresho byasukuwe maze bakabihindura ibikorwa by'ubuhanzi bidasanzwe. Buri gice gifite inkuru y'ibikoresho byacyo n'uwagikoze.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Buri gikorwa cy'ubuhanzi cyandikwa hamwe n'ibipimo birambuye by'ingaruka - kilo z'imyanda yakuwemo, ibikoresho byakoreshejwe, n'amafaranga umuhanzi yinjije.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Ibikorwa by'ubuhanzi byemewe bishyirwa ku isoko ryacu hamwe n'inkuru zuzuye z'ingaruka, amashusho meza, n'ibiciro bigaragara.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Abaguzi bavumbura kandi bakagura ibikorwa by'ubuhanzi bidasanzwe, byemejwe ingaruka. Buri igurisha rishyigikira abahanzi ku buryo butaziguye kandi rikagaburira ikusanya ry'imyanda rikomeza.

contact.faqSubheading: Ibisubizo byihuse ku bibazo bisanzwe ku RenewCanvas Africa.
contact.faq1Answer: Ushobora gusaba ukoresheje ifishi yo gusaba kuba umuhanzi iri hejuru. Dusuzuma ibyifuzo byose kandi dushaka abahanzi bakunda ubuhanzi burambye kandi bafite porotofoliyo yerekana imirimo yabo.
contact.faq2Question: Ni ibihe bikoresho mutanga ku bahanzi?
contact.faq2Answer: Dutanga ibikoresho byo gucungururwa byasukuwe kandi byatondetswe harimo amacupa ya pulasitiki, agakarito, ibice by'imyenda, n'ibindi. Ibikoresho byose birasukuwe kandi biteguye gukoreshwa mu buhanzi.
contact.faq3Question: Gahunda yo guhindura imyanda mu busembuzi ikora ite?
contact.faq3Answer: Saba gukusanya binyuze kuri pulatifomu yacu, maze tuze gufata ibikoresho byawe byo gucungururwa. Uzahabwa kode z'igabanyirizwa hashingiwe ku biro by'ibikoresho watanze. Uko utanga byinshi, ni ko igabanyirizwa ryawe ku kugura ubuhanzi rikura.
contact.faq4Answer: Dutangirira ku gutanga mu Rwanda kandi vuba tuzakwirakwiza ku kohereza mu mahanga. Iyandikishe kugira ngo umenyeshwe igihe kohereza mu mahanga bizaba bihari.
contact.faq5Question: Ese abaguzi bashobora kuvugana n'abahanzi mu buryo butaziguye?
contact.faq5Answer: Oya. Abayobozi ba RenewCanvas ni bo bacunga itumanaho ku byerekeye ibicuruzwa, gutanga, gusubiza, no kwishyura. Abaguzi bishyura RenewCanvas Africa mu buryo butaziguye, naho abahanzi bakishyurwa binyuze mu makuru yabo yihariye yo kwishyurwa nyuma y'igihe cy'amasaha 48 cyo gusaba gusubiza.

terms.section1Body1: Murakaza neza kuri RenewCanvas Africa ("Pulatifomu", "twe", "yacu", "twebwe"). Aya Mabwiriza n'Amategeko agenga uko ukoresha pulatifomu na serivisi zacu. Mu kwinjira cyangwa gukoresha RenewCanvas Africa, wemera kuyobokera aya mabwiriza.
terms.section1Body2: RenewCanvas Africa ni isoko ry'ubukungu buzunguruka rihuza abahanzi bakora ubuhanzi burambye bavuye mu bikoresho byacunguruwe n'abaguzi bakunda ubuhanzi bwita ku bidukikije.
terms.section2Def1: bivuga abakoresha biyandikishije bakora kandi bacuruza ubuhanzi kuri pulatifomu.
terms.section2Def2: bivuga abakoresha biyandikishije bagura ubuhanzi binyuze kuri pulatifomu.
terms.section2Def3: bivuga igice icyo ari cyo cyose cy'ubuhanzi cyakozwe mu bikoresho byacunguruwe cyangwa byongeye gukoreshwa cyashyizwe ku rutonde rwo kugurishwa kuri pulatifomu.
terms.section2Def4: bivuga ibiranga n'imikorere byose bitangwa na RenewCanvas Africa.
terms.section3Body: Kugira ngo ukoreshe serivisi zacu, ugomba gukora konti. Wemera:
terms.section3Item1: Gutanga amakuru yukuri kandi yuzuye mu kwiyandikisha
terms.section3Item2: Kubungabunga umutekano w'amakuru y'ibanga ya konti yawe
terms.section3Item3: Kutumenyesha ako kanya iyo hari uwinjiye nta ruhushya
terms.section3Item4: Kuba ufite nibura imyaka 18 cyangwa ufite uruhushya rw'ababyeyi
terms.section3Item5: Kwemera kwishingira ibikorwa byose biri munsi ya konti yawe
terms.section4Item1: Gukora ubuhanzi bwawe ukoresheje ibikoresho byacunguruwe cyangwa byongeye gukoreshwa
terms.section4Item2: Gusobanura neza ubuhanzi bwawe, harimo ibikoresho byakoreshejwe n'ingano
terms.section4Item3: Gutanga amakuru y'ukuri ku ngaruka ku bidukikije z'ibikoresho byawe
terms.section4Item5: Gupakira ubuhanzi neza kugira ngo butangwe
terms.section5Item1: Gutanga amakuru yukuri yo gutanga ibintu
terms.section5Item3: Gusuzuma ubuhanzi igihe butanzwe no kumenyesha ibibazo byihuse
terms.section6Body: Ibiciro byose byerekanwa mu Mafaranga y'u Rwanda (RWF). Twemera uburyo bwo kwishyura bukurikira:
terms.section6Item1: Kwemeza kwa telefoni kwa MTN Mobile Money, hamwe na USSD nk'inkunga
terms.section6CommissionBody: RenewCanvas Africa igumana 20% ya buri gucuruza nk'amafaranga ya pulatifomu. Abahanzi bahabwa 80% by'igiciro cyo kugurisha.
terms.section7Body: Abahanzi bagumana uburenganzira bwuzuye bw'umutungo w'ubwenge ku buhanzi bwabo. Mu gushyira ubuhanzi ku rutonde kuri pulatifomu yacu, abahanzi baha RenewCanvas Africa uruhushya rutihariye rwo kwerekana no guteza imbere imirimo yabo.
terms.section8Item1: Kuba ari umwimerere cyangwa byahawe uruhushya neza
terms.section8Item2: Kutarenga ku burenganzira bw'undi muntu wese
terms.section8Item3: Kutarimo ibikubiyemo bibabaza, byangiza, cyangwa binyuranyije n'amategeko
terms.section9Body: Abahanzi ni bo bashinzwe gahunda yo kohereza keretse byavuzwe ukundi. Igihe cyo gutanga gishobora gutandukana hashingiwe ku hantu. RenewCanvas Africa ntishinzwe gutinda kohereza biterwa n'abatwara abandi.
terms.section10Body: Mu gihe habaye impaka hagati y'abaguzi n'abahanzi, RenewCanvas Africa izorohereza itumanaho kandi ishobora kuvugana hagati kugira ngo igere ku gisubizo cy'ubutabera. Icyemezo cyacu muri ibyo bibazo kizaba ari cyo cya nyuma.
terms.section11Body: RenewCanvas Africa ikora nk'ihuriro hagati y'abahanzi n'abaguzi. Ntidushinzwe:
terms.section11Item2: Ukuri kw'ibyavuzwe ku ngaruka ku bidukikije
terms.section11Item4: Ibyangiritse bitaziguye cyangwa biva ku bindi
terms.section12Body: Twiteguye uburenganzira bwo guhagarika cyangwa gufunga konti zinyuranyije n'aya mabwiriza, zigira uruhare mu bikorwa by'uburiganya, cyangwa zangiza umuryango wa pulatifomu.

terms.section15Body: Ku bibazo bijyanye na aya Mabwiriza n'Amategeko, nyamuneka tuvugane:

privacy.section1Para1: RenewCanvas Africa ("twe", "yacu", "twebwe") yiyemeje kurinda ibanga ryawe. Iri Politiki y'Ibanga isobanura uko dukusanya, dukoresha, dutangaza, kandi turinda amakuru yawe igihe ukoresha pulatifomu na serivisi zacu.
privacy.section1Para2: Mu gukoresha RenewCanvas Africa, wemera imikorere y'amakuru isobanuwe muri iyi politiki.
privacy.section2_1Intro: Dukusanya amakuru utanga mu buryo butaziguye, harimo:
privacy.section2_1Item1: Izina n'amakuru yo kuvugana (imeri, nimero ya telefoni, aderesi)
privacy.section2_1Item2: Amakuru y'ibanga ya konti (izina ry'ukoresha, ijambobanga)
privacy.section2_1Item3: Amakuru yo kwishyura (atunganywa mu mutekano binyuze ku batanga serivisi zo kwishyura)
privacy.section2_1Item4: Amakuru y'umwirondoro (ubuzima bugufi, ifoto y'umwirondoro, amahuza y'imbuga nkoranyambaga)
privacy.section2_2Item2: Ibikoresho byakoreshejwe n'amakuru y'ingaruka ku bidukikije
privacy.section2_3Intro: Dukusanya amakuru amwe mu buryo bwikora igihe usura pulatifomu yacu:
privacy.section2_3Item2: Aderesi ya IP n'amakuru y'aho uri
privacy.section2_3Item3: Imikorere yo gukoresha n'imyitwarire yo gushakisha
privacy.section3Item2: Gutunganya ibikorwa byo gucuruza no kwishyura
privacy.section3Item3: Kwemeza umwirondoro w'abahanzi no kwemeza umwimerere w'ubuhanzi
privacy.section3Item4: Kubara no kwerekana ibipimo by'ingaruka ku bidukikije
privacy.section3Item5: Kuvugana nawe ku byerekeye ibicuruzwa, ivugurura, n'amamenyesha
privacy.section4Item1Text: Abahanzi n'abaguzi bashobora kubonana amakuru y'umwe n'undi ajyanye n'icyo gikorwa kugira ngo borohereze ibikorwa byo gucuruza
privacy.section4Item2Text: Abandi badufasha gukoresha pulatifomu yacu (abatunganya kwishyura, serivisi zo gucumbikira)
privacy.section4Item3Text: Igihe bisabwa n'amategeko cyangwa kurinda uburenganzira bwacu
privacy.section4Item4Text: Mu gihe cy'ihuriro, kugura, cyangwa kugurisha umutungo
privacy.section4Outro: Ntitugurisha amakuru yawe bwite ku bandi.
privacy.section5Intro: Dushyira mu bikorwa ingamba z'umutekano zikwiye z'ikoranabuhanga n'iz'imitunganyirize zo kurinda amakuru yawe, harimo:
privacy.section5Item1: Gusobeka amakuru mu nzira no aho ari
privacy.section5Item4: Igenzura ryo kugera no guhugura abakozi
privacy.section5Outro: Ariko, nta buryo bwo kohereza kuri interineti bwizewe ku 100%. Ntidushobora kwemeza umutekano wuzuye.
privacy.section6Intro: Dukoresha cookies n'ikoranabuhanga risa kugira ngo:
privacy.section6Item1: Kwibuka ibyo ukunda n'imiterere yo kwinjira
privacy.section6Outro: Ushobora kugenzura cookies binyuze mu igenamiterere rya mucukumbuzi yawe, ariko bimwe mu biranga bishobora kudakora neza udafite zo.
privacy.section7Item2: Gukosora amakuru atari yo cyangwa atuzuye
privacy.section7Item5: Gutwara amakuru (kwakira amakuru yawe mu buryo bushobora gukoreshwa)
privacy.section7Item6: Gukuraho uburenganzira igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
privacy.section7Outro: Kugira ngo ukoreshe ubu burenganzira, tuvugane kuri {{email}}.
privacy.section8Intro: Tubika amakuru yawe igihe cyose bikenewe kugira ngo dutange serivisi zacu kandi twuzuze impamvu zasobanuwe muri iyi politiki. Nyuma yo gusiba konti:
privacy.section8Item2: Inyandiko z'ibikorwa byo gucuruza zishobora kubikwa ku mpamvu z'amategeko n'iz'ibaruramari (kugeza ku myaka 7)
privacy.section8Item3: Amakuru atazwi nyirayo ashobora kubikwa ku isesengura
privacy.section9Para1: Pulatifomu yacu ntigenewe abana bari munsi y'imyaka 18. Ntidukusanya tubizi amakuru bwite y'abana. Niba utekereza ko twakusanyije amakuru y'umwana, nyamuneka tuvugane ako kanya.
privacy.section10Para1: Amakuru yawe ashobora kwimurirwa no gutunganyirizwa mu bindi bihugu bitari u Rwanda. Twemeza ko ingamba zikwiye zihari kugira ngo turinde amakuru yawe hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.
privacy.section11Para1: Pulatifomu yacu ishobora kuba irimo amahuza y'imbuga z'abandi. Ntitushinzwe imikorere yabo y'ibanga. Tugushishikariza gusoma politiki zabo z'ibanga mbere yo gutanga amakuru ayo ari yo yose.
privacy.section12Para1: Abahanzi n'abakoresha bashobora gutanga ibikubiyemo kuri pulatifomu, harimo amashusho y'ubuhanzi, amakuru y'umwirondoro, ibisobanuro, n'ubutumwa ("Ibikubiyemo by'Umukoresha"). Ushinzwe ibikubiyemo utanga kandi wemeza ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kubisangiza. Mu gutanga Ibikubiyemo by'Umukoresha uha RenewCanvas Africa uruhushya rutihariye rwo kubyerekana, kubigana, no kubiteza imbere ku mikorere n'imamaza by'isoko.
privacy.section12Para2: Dushobora gusuzuma, kugenzura, cyangwa gukuraho ibikubiyemo binyuranyije n'amategeko, birenga ku burenganzira, cyangwa bivuguruza amabwiriza yacu. Kugira ngo umenyeshe ibikubiyemo cyangwa usabe kubikuraho, tuvugane kuri {{email}}.
privacy.section13Para1: Niba uri umuturage wa Californiya, ufite uburenganzira bwo kumenya amakuru bwite dukusanya n'uko tuyakoresha, gusaba kugera cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite, gukosora amakuru atari yo, no kutavangurwa kubera gukoresha ubu burenganzira.
privacy.section13Para2: Ntitugurisha amakuru yawe bwite, kandi ntidu"sangira" ku kwamamaza gushingiye ku myitwarire hagati y'ibikorwa nk'uko bisobanurwa muri CPRA. Kugira ngo ukoreshe uburenganzira bwawe bwa Californiya, ohereza imeri kuri {{email}} ufite umutwe "California Privacy Request". Tuzemeza icyifuzo cyawe mbere yo kugikora.
privacy.section14Para1: Dushobora kuvugurura iyi Politiki y'Ibanga igihe kigeze. Tuzakumenyesha impinduka zikomeye binyuze kuri imeri cyangwa imenyesha rya pulatifomu. Gukomeza gukoresha pulatifomu nyuma y'impinduka bisobanura kwemera politiki yavuguruwe.
